correctness.rationale: The proof first rules out zero leaves, then enumerates exactly the independent label choices in outside, boundary-zero and interior-zero root classes. Each admissible root zero set contributes a unique nonnegative polynomial term, establishing the exact all-graph weight enumerator. Cyclic run-and-gap compositions count each proper admissible cycle subset exactly n/k times before removing the k anchors; empty/full cases are separate. Exact brute-force ternary enumerations, cycle polynomial comparisons and extremal-count checks corroborate the proof within recorded finite ranges, not beyond.

value.rationale: The precise all-weight RID-function distribution of an arbitrary single-leaf corona depends only on a natural induced-boundary profile, not merely on a minimum cardinality. Its cycle specialization has explicit coefficients and counts all minimum functions, providing structural information unavailable from scalar domination numbers. It is a reusable graph-polynomial transform and natural infinite-family classification rather than an arbitrary finite recomputation.
